quaere: Aim at Data platform first, not because it has more roles, but because its top asks sit inside the two highest-value readiness moves already queued: production-grade Python and customer-site fluency. Agent engineer and Frontier lab look tempting but their asks, agent design, RAG, evals, are not on the plan at all yet. The tier order is really a sequencing signal. Zero percent across every segment is the honest month-one floor, not a verdict. The dashboard is also incomplete: relocation and visa are partly inferred, scan depth is shallow, so segment picks are provisional. Until velocity builds and the JD body gets extracted, treat the ranking as a direction, not a destination, and let the Python plus travel narrative moves pull you up the leaderboard before chasing agent or lab depth that the plan has not earned.
